project.title: S&P 500 Stock Movement Predictor
project.subtitle: Explore historical stock prices and predict whether a stock may move UP or DOWN in the next trading session using an LSTM model.
project.author: Srinath Rao

train.name: Training
train.regime: Dot-com burst, 2008 GFC, post-crisis expansion, low-rate quantitative easing

val.name: Validation
val.regime: Trade wars, COVID-19 crash & swift stimulus recovery, 2021 tech rally

test.name: Test (Out-of-Sample)
test.regime: Aggressive Fed rate hikes, 2022 bear market, disinflation, GenAI rally

scalerFeatures.description: Relative volume delta with zero-volume safe division
20-day trailing rolling standard deviation of daily return
20-day Simple Moving Average of Close price
50-day Simple Moving Average of Close price
Price to 50-day SMA intermediate trend ratio

experiments.Experiment: Experiment D: Low LR (LB=30, Hidden=64, LR=0.0005)

AAPL.explanation: The PyTorch LSTM model evaluated the 30 consecutive trading sessions from 2026-01-08 to 2026-02-20. Accounting for normalized momentum, volume dynamics, volatility, and SMA stretch, the model outputs a UP movement probability of 53.0%.
AAPL.caution: Experimental prediction based on 51.75% out-of-sample directional accuracy. This does not guarantee future results and is not financial advice.
